g.text: Identify the best inverse scaler for a given resolution.
Compares multiple kernels against a specific target resolution to determine which one
was likely used for the original upscaling.
Path to the source material to analyze. Supports videos, images, or VapourSynth scripts.
The suspected native resolution to verify.
Base integer dimension if checking for fractional resolution.
Edge-detection mask to reduce noise influence on the metric.
Specifies whether to analyze based on the height or width of the frame.
The kernel(s) to use for inverse scaling. Can be a kernel name or a class call with
Whether to process rescale in linear light.
The specific frame number to extract and analyze from video inputs. Ignored for images.
Crop the input frame before analysis to remove black bars (LEFT RIGHT TOP BOTTOM).
The mathematical metric used to compare scaling results (MAE, MSE, RMSE).
The VapourSynth indexer used to load files.
[choices: zipsource, vszip, lsmas, d2vwitch, d2v, ffms2, bestsource, bs]
Show the default checked kernels for getscaler and exit.
Show the builtin supported kernels from vskernels and exit.
Show the supported edge masks from vsmasktools and exit.
- getscaler gives heuristic results; it's not infallible.
- Always visually verify the suggested scaler and parameters on multiple frames before trusting them.
